Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:81552: kernel security update (Important)
Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: drm/xe/uapi: Reject coh_none PAT index for CPU cached memory in madvise (CVE-2026-46309)

* kernel: macsec: fix replay protection at XPN lower-PN wrap (CVE-2026-63925)

* kernel: bpf: Support for hardening against JIT spraying (CVE-2026-64508)

* kernel: x86/bugs: Enable IBPB flush on BPF JIT allocation (CVE-2026-64507)

* kernel: drm/amd/display: set new_stream to NULL after release (CVE-2026-68236)

* kernel: drm/dp/mst: fix buffer overflows in sideband chunk accumulation (CVE-2026-68278)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix lifetime issue of amdgpu_vm_get_task_info_pasid() (CVE-2026-68245)

* kernel: openvswitch: fix GSO userspace truncation underflow (CVE-2026-68123)

* kernel: cifs: validate DFS referral string offsets (CVE-2026-72318)

* kernel: drm/vmwgfx: use check_add_overflow for shader size+offset bound (CVE-2026-80887)

* kernel: nvmet-auth: Synchronize timeout work during SQ teardown (CVE-2026-89970)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Add TLB flush after MES queue eviction/suspension (CVE-2026-89811)

* kernel: media: cx231xx: reject geometry changes while the VBI queue is busy (CVE-2026-89894)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
